before.basis: Inspected all42 existing source34/35/38 open-response checks: none mentions sigma/3σ. Existing day20 explains assumptions but gives only a rangeR worked exercise.

independentExample.comparison: Two stable normal processes with identical means and different sigma; asks interval fit and whether shifting center alone can solve excess width. Source82 has a single-process yield-reduction example; no source numbers, question structure or prose copied.

scopeLimits: Normal and stable distribution is an explicit exercise assumption, not a diagnosis of a real factory.
